 A promise of youth, an unforgettable melody, and the relentless passage of time filled with dreams, heartbreak, and nostalgia. 
Stream the full movie "The Fourteenth Sunday of Ordinary Time" (La quattordicesima domenica del tempo ordinario, 2023), a deeply poignant autobiographical work written and directed by Italian maestro Pupi Avati. Featuring masterful performances by Gabriele Lavia, Edwige Fenech, Lodo Guenzi, Camilla Ciraolo, Massimo Lopez, and Nick Russo. Watch it free, full-length, and in High Definition (HD 1080p)!

[Synopsis]
Bologna, 1970s. Samuele and Marzio are two inseparable teenagers bonded by their love of music and a shared ambition to make it as singer-songwriters under the band name "I Leggenda". Bound by brotherhood, they swear a lifelong pact of friendship that nothing can ever break. Everything seems golden when Marzio meets Sandra, the most stunning and pursued girl in town, falling hopelessly in love and eventually marrying her on a fateful fourteenth Sunday in Ordinary Time.

However, as the decades roll by, the harsh realities of adulthood, financial compromises, professional disappointments, and romantic disillusionment begin to take their toll. The marriage crumbles, the music career never takes flight, and the unbreakable bond between the two lifelong friends slowly fades into silence and distance. Thirty-five years later, now older and weathered by life's regrets, Marzio and Sandra cross paths once again, discovering that the heart's melody never truly died.
